title: Firefly and Comet: How to combat the new ARC enemies
body:
# Firefly and Comet: How to combat the new ARC enemies

Raiders,

Has a Comet ever blown you sky high? Has a Firefly ever scorched you to a crisp?

Two fresh ARC machines have appeared topside, and each one calls for a different survival plan. Whether a hovering flamethrower is chasing you down or a rolling bomb is stalking your every move, quick thinking and fast reactions are essential.

Nobody understands these threats better than the people who built them: the ARC Raiders development team. Below are their tips for surviving an encounter with either of these new ARC units.

# Firefly

This flying ARC breaks the usual mould. The Wasp and the Hornet tend to keep their distance, giving you time to duck into cover, but the Firefly is relentless and bold. It may hesitate at first, but it will chase you into dead ends and rain fire down from above without hesitation.

"Bring a Photoelectric Cloak" **Junsik, Machine Learning Engineer**

This tip isn't exactly comforting coming from someone who trains the ARC to fight. His advice is that vanishing is your best defense against becoming a well-cooked Raider. A Photoelectric Cloak scrambles the ARC's sensors and makes you invisible for a short time. If that's the recommended approach, the Firefly is clearly not to be underestimated.

"Aim for the yellow gas tank, it's a good way to take them out" **Alexander, Gameplay Programmer**

This is the useful part. Fireflies have to store their fuel somewhere, and if you look carefully, you'll spot the oil tank holding their flame fuel. Hitting it is a difficult shot, but landing it might be the quickest way to send these machines to their end.

"Running away is not the play. If you can't fight, get inside" **Leon, Fullstack Engineer**

Turning your back on a Firefly is as risky as turning your back on a tiger. These machines hunt relentlessly and are skilled at tracking Raiders. Often they'll wait while you're already fighting something else, then swoop in to force you out of cover. That means sprinting to safety isn't an option. Getting caught in the open means you'll be burned before you can even think about returning to Speranza. Solid cover offers some protection, but being indoors is far safer. Anything less leaves you exposed to danger.

"Always be kind to your fellow Raiders, unless you run into a Firefly, in which case throw a Lure Grenade at them and run" **Sherilynne, Quality Analyst**

On that warm note, let's move along.

# Comet

Where the Firefly relies on cunning and patience, the Comet charges in without hesitation. This heavily armored, explosive rolling sphere affects Raiders differently, some find it sharpens their focus, others just want to flee. Its blast radius is wide and its impact hits hard. Staying anywhere near a Comet once it starts its self-destruct sequence is a bad idea.

"Aggro the Comet from a distance. It'll open up, exposing the inner weak point" **David, Senior Game Designer**

Despite its heavy armor, the Comet has a vulnerable spot like any other ARC machine. It isn't immediately visible, but once you draw its fire, the Comet opens up slightly, revealing its more delicate internal components for you to target.

"Use automatic weapons" **Oskar, Code and Animation Developer**

Heavy-hitting weapons such as the Anvil or the Ferro have limits here. What actually matters is landing as many hits as possible in the shortest time. Swapping armor piercing rounds for ammunition with a higher fire rate can help you wear the Comet down faster.

"When in a group, spread out. The Comet will try to get in the middle of your squad to inflict maximum damage" **Nora, Tech Designer**

The Comet may charge recklessly, but it's not without strategy. It aims for maximum damage since it only gets one shot at hurting you, so where it positions itself matters a great deal. Spread out from your teammates so you don't all get caught in the blast, and remember, the explosion is massive, so keep your distance.

"Shoot off the armor plating on the sides" **Victor, Game Programmer**

If you want to maximize damage and rip that armor away by force, target the sides. This approach may bring you closer to destroying a Comet than firing straight at its center.

That said, if the Comet is charging at you, holding your ground and staying steady could let you strike its weak point head-on, just make sure you don't miss.

# Good luck out there

Both of these new ARC machines hunt with purpose and hit hard. You won't always be able to win a direct confrontation, but with sharp thinking and quick footwork, you can learn to outlast them.

Best of luck out there, The ARC Raiders Team
